candidate_ref: current working tree AAA-007 browser provisioning inspection

source_documents.role: The Web consumer lane owns Playwright and provisions Chromium before browser snapshots on supported CI runners.
The browser test inventory and bounded runner use the package-owned Playwright Chromium executable.

findings.summary: The repository already has a concrete owner: apps/web declares Playwright, ci.yml installs Chromium with hosted dependencies before the Web consumer gates, and ci-master installs Chromium on its persistent runner.
findings.limitations: The evidence is repository-local and cannot guarantee network or OS package availability on an external runner.

findings.summary: A local workspace with the npm package installed but no browser binary fails at chromium.launch with the standard command to install the browser. This is the expected pre-provisioning behavior and matches the CI setup owner; no product or CI edit is required.
findings.limitations: The full Web snapshot lane remains unexecuted locally because downloading the browser and OS packages is outside this diagnostic action.

decision.diagnosis: The audit claim is retired by current repository evidence: supported CI runners provision the pinned Chromium artifact before Web consumers, and an unprovisioned local runner reports one actionable prerequisite diagnostic.
decision.next_action: Complete AAA-007 without a code change and continue to the next independent expected-output reproduction.

validation.validation_method: Parse commands.jsonl and findings.json; verify all five raw-output files and SHA-256 digests; confirm CI provisioning order, pinned browser resolution, expected missing-browser failure, Web lane ownership, and git diff --check.
